visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of logo or award badge images with no text
visualCharacteristics.layout: image-only grid, 2 columns on mobile and 4 on tablet/desktop, logos contained and centred

contentPattern.structure: One row per logo; first cell is the badge image (with alt text), second cell may be left empty

reuseGuidance: Use for award badges, partner or customer logo walls. Always provide alt text for each logo.
